bias_targets.methodology: Comparing speech-to-text hallucination rates between speakers with aphasia (a speech impairment) and a control group using audio segments from AphasiaBank, measuring disfluencies via Voice Activity Detection, and running logistic regression models that also test for hearing and vision loss.
Evaluated by including racial demographic categories (African American, Other Race) as covariates in a logistic regression model predicting the likelihood of model hallucinations.
Evaluated by including gender (female) as a covariate in a logistic regression model predicting the likelihood of model hallucinations.
Evaluated by including age and age-squared as demographic covariates in a logistic regression model predicting the likelihood of model hallucinations.
Evaluated by including years of education as a covariate in a logistic regression model predicting the likelihood of model hallucinations.
Evaluated by including whether English is the speaker's first language as a covariate in a logistic regression model predicting the likelihood of model hallucinations.
